item.title: Keybase: Keys for everyone! Part II
item.dc:creator: Christopher Laing
item.description: In a previous post , we discussed Keybase , a clever company that is solving a lot of the classic problems that users have had with PGP: managing keys, verifying identities, trusting third parties, and user experience.

item.title: Keybase: Keys for everyone! Part I
item.dc:creator: Christopher Laing
item.description: Encryption is a topic that has fascinated me for years, less because of its mathematical basis than its applications, both existing and potential. By far my favourite project in this realm is Keybase .
